name: Draenor-Core Build & Runtime
description: Build tracking and fix documentation for getting EyalMK/Draenor-Core (World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor, patch 6.2.3, build 20779) to configure and compile on a modern Linux toolchain — GCC 13 / OpenSSL 3.x / ACE 7.1.2 / Boost 1.83. The upstream project targets an older Windows/Visual Studio + OpenSSL 1.x era toolchain, so a fresh clone does not build cleanly on current Linux. The fixes needed to get it building are catalogued in BUILD.md, grouped by root cause so the same patterns can be recognized and fixed if they recur deeper in the build.
runCommand: podman exec draenor-devbox bash -lc 'cd /home/blizz/Draenor-Core/run-world && rm -f console.fifo && mkfifo console.fifo && exec 9<>console.fifo && exec ./worldserver < console.fifo >> worldserver-live.log 2>&1'
testCommand: podman exec draenor-devbox bash -lc 'ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,comm,args | grep "[.]\/worldserver" || true; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8085 || true; tail -40 /home/blizz/Draenor-Core/run-world/worldserver-live.log'
